palette_child_interpretation: C17 uses a direct pixel affine inverse when identifiable. L07/L08/L09 instead use24-bin occupied-colour nodes and a prior-regularized objective on those cases. These are comparisons of complete implementations, not isolated likelihood ablations; affine and ambiguous cohorts are reported separately.

runtime_policy.timing: Per-image median candidate seconds, including preparation and native projection
runtime_policy.interpretation: Five IoU percentage points per excess second; no bonus below one second
runtime_policy.historical_scope: Posthoc display for cycles1-4; signed historical selections unchanged

interpretation: Paired development differences, not independent validation or significance evidence. No cross-cycle speedup claim; utility differences use only current-cycle per-image times. Constant evidence uses a common fallback; it is not a refinement gain.
